name: Broken Blades
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of rust)

EFFECT

Range 20 feet
Effect radius emanation centered on you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

All weapons within the radius rust, tarnish, and splinter. They gain the broken condition and their hardness is halved.

Any weapon removed from the aura loses the broken condition unless it sustained enough damage otherwise.
